title: Design System: SBIC Consignment Webapp - Food And Beverages

display.purpose: Home screen welcome name, splash/login wordmark. At most once per screen.

headline.purpose: The confirmed Business Central document number on Submit's success screen.

title.purpose: Primary list-item text: customer names, item descriptions, draft summaries.

body.purpose: Metadata lines, form values, secondary list text.

label.purpose: Field labels and section labels, uppercase, muted or FEFO-gold-dark.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card lift, faintly blue-tinted rather than neutral gray.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Reserved for modals/sheets needing more separation than a card; unused by shipped components today.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for any state transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every primary action: Sign In, Start New Session, Add Item, Add to Order, Submit to Business Central.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2461A8; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.2s var(--ds-ease, cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3970B3; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #123159; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2461A8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #CBD3DC; color: #8991A0; }

components.name: Outline Stepper Button
components.description: Quantity +/- controls in the Add Items modal — blue outline, no fill, inherits interactive color without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #2461A8; border: 1px solid #2461A8; border-radius: 8px; width: 36px; height: 36px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #E4EDF7; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { color: #CBD3DC; border-color: #DBE4F0; }

components.name: Wayfinding Badge
components.description: Leading circular icon badge before the Customer and Posting Date fields on Scan, and each draft row on Home. Purely navigational, never status.
components.css: .ds-badge-wayfind { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: #E4EDF7; color: #2461A8; }

components.name: Expiry Warning Chip
components.description: The signature component: appears identically wherever an expiry date is shown, meaning exactly one thing (within 14 days of expiry). Never used decoratively.
components.css: .ds-chip-expiry { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #FAF0D6; color: #A9840F; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: middle; }

components.name: Order Line Card List Item
components.description: The core content row across Scan and Submit: item name, quantity/UOM, and expiry with its warning chip when applicable.

components.css: .ds-line-item { background: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #DBE4F0; } .ds-line-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #12203A; margin: 0 0 2px; } .ds-line-meta, .ds-line-expiry { font-size: 14px; color: #6B7686; margin: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Customer summary card on Submit, and any grouped-content surface.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #DBE4F0; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(36, 97, 168, 0.10), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 16px; } .ds-card-subtitle { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #6B7686; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #12203A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard form field (Order Number, search bars) — flush inside its row, blue focus highlight.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Order Number *</label><input class="ds-input" placeholder="Enter the online order number" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B7686; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #DBE4F0; background: transparent; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; color: #12203A; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #2461A8; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 #2461A8; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Top toolbar — Storage Navy background, white title, FEFO Gold Light icons (brand-accent role, not a semantic signal here).
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #12203A; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-header-back { background: none; border: none; color: #D9B041; font-size: 20px; } .ds-header-title { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin: 0; font-size: 16px; }

narrative.overview: Every screen exists to optimize one loop: pick a customer, confirm what's actually available right now, catch what's expiring, submit, done. Nothing here is decorative — color, shape, and hierarchy all point at making that loop faster and less error-prone for someone standing in a storage room, phone or tablet in one hand, stock in the other. This is a tool, not a showcase; competence reads as calm, not flashy. Before this pass, color lived only in the app's chrome (header, tab bar) — every content screen was effectively grayscale. That was a missed opportunity, not a stylistic choice: the interface had nothing to say about hierarchy, wayfinding, or the one piece of information that genuinely matters in food & beverage consignment — how soon something expires. This system fixes that with two disciplined moves: a single interactive blue (Deep Harbor Blue) for anything the user can act on or needs as a key value, and a single reserved gold (FEFO Gold) for exactly one meaning — expiry proximity — never used decoratively.
keyCharacteristics: One interactive/key-value accent (blue), one strictly-semantic accent (gold), nothing else competing for attention
Flat-to-quiet elevation — shadows exist but are barely-there, never a design statement
Generous touch targets and high-contrast text, because this is used one-handed under inconsistent warehouse lighting
Color always means the same thing wherever it appears — never one-off decoration

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every color means exactly one thing, everywhere it appears. Gold is expiry/low-stock, full stop. Blue is "act on this or read this key value," full stop.

rules.name: The No-Reskin Rule
rules.body: This app does not borrow the garments app's gold-primary/dark-secondary identity. Blue leads here; gold is a narrow, functional signal, not the second half of a matching color pair.

rules.name: The Single-Voice Rule
rules.body: One font family, always. Hierarchy is entirely scale + weight + color, never a second typeface pretending to be editorial contrast.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: If a shadow is visible enough to describe out loud, it's too strong. Elevation here is a structural cue, not a visual flourish.

dos: Do use Deep Harbor Blue (#2461A8) for every interactive element and every key-value moment.
Do reserve FEFO Gold (#D4A72C / #A9840F dark) exclusively for expiry-proximity and low-stock signals.
Do keep every neutral tinted (cool blue-gray), never pure #fff or #000 for large surfaces.
Do keep shadows barely-visible (rgba(...,0.06-0.12)) — elevation is structural, not decorative.
Do size touch targets generously for one-handed, tablet/phone use in variable lighting.
donts: Don't reskin the garments app's gold-primary/dark-secondary identity.
Don't build a generic admin-dashboard look.
Don't add consumer-app gloss: no bounce/elastic motion, no rounded-everything playfulness.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored status stripe on any card, list item, or callout.
Don't introduce a second decorative accent color.
